component.name: EPUB Compressor
component.summary: Reduce the size of EPUB books by recompressing their artwork

description.p: EPUB Compressor shrinks EPUB books by recompressing the images inside them. Book text is never touched: only artwork is re-encoded, and only when doing so actually makes the file smaller.

Books can be reduced in place, with the untouched original archived to a Backups folder and restorable at any time, or written out as new files. Presets target common e-readers, and a size target can be set directly.
Finished books can be sent straight to an Audiobookshelf server, with the title, author, series and other details read from the book itself.
PySide6 interface, standalone Audiobookshelf upload, full EPUB metadata extraction, and e-reader presets.
